patthana18.11:1.1: hetusampayuttaṃ hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu sampayutto na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi.
patthana18.11:2.1: hetu vippayuttaṃ hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu vippayutto na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi. hetuyā cha.
patthana18.11:3.1: hetusampayuttaṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu vippayutto na na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā tīṇi.
